    { "component": "validation-message", "property": "announce" },
    { "component": "validation-message", "property": "id" }
  ],
  "installCommands": [
    "npx shadcn add @skrewww/form-field",
    "npx shadcn add @skrewww/text-input",
    "npx shadcn add @skrewww/validation-message"
  ],
  "maturityClaims": [
    { "component": "form-field", "status": "stable" },
    { "component": "text-input", "status": "stable" },
    { "component": "validation-message", "status": "stable" }
  ],
  "shapeMode": "rounded",
  "surfaceMode": "glass",
  "skrewwwRegistryConfigured": true,
  "recipeIdsUsed": ["validated-text-field"],
  "accessibilityFacts": [
    "Form Field associates label text with the nested control through htmlFor/id via a stable controlId.",
    "Text Input must have a visible or aria-labelled label — never rely on placeholder text alone; in this Recipe Form Field owns the single visible label.",
    "Error state needs aria-invalid and aria-describedby; Validation Message id is wired for that association.",
    "Do not convey validity by color alone — Validation Message text (and type) must carry the meaning.",
    "Prefer one Validation Message announcement for this field; avoid stacking duplicate live regions for the same error."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "None of form-field, text-input, or validation-message are installed yet in the fixture (no matching distribution file paths present), so registry installs are required.",
    "Email semantics are expressed via Form Field label/supportingText and client validation messaging; Text Input contract does not list a type prop."
  ],
  "unresolvedGaps": [
    "Text Input api.properties does not include type (e.g. email), value, onChange, or id — native/control wiring beyond the declared props is not modeled in the contract."
  ],
  "implementation": "Install @skrewww/form-field, @skrewww/text-input, and @skrewww/validation-message. On app/page.tsx, compose Recipe validated-text-field: FormField with controlId (e.g. email), label \"Email\", required, optional supportingText, and error when invalid; children render-prop receives controlId/describedBy/invalid and renders TextInput with matching required/error (Form Field owns the label — do not also pass TextInput label). When invalid, set FormField error and render ValidationMessage type=\"error\" with id linked for aria-describedby and announce per contract. Preserve layout data-skrewww-shape=\"rounded\" and data-skrewww-surface=\"glass\"."
}
